newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index down, trade up.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index down, trade up.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.48 percent in trade boosted by over-the-counter business, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 580.05 from 581.74 on Thursday.
Trade volume was 7.36 million dinars against 2.34 million. Most of the exchanges were over-the-counter with a turnover of six million dinars.

UBCI bank was down 4.53 dinars to 47.5 dinars. Banque de l'Habitat eased 1.2 dinar to 38.73 dinars. Banque du Sud down 1.04 dinar to 23.96 dinars. STB bank was down 0.68 dinar to 22.03 dinars. ($=one dinar)
